title: One More Card
description: Spend $100 to build a chain of suited links. Combine Growth, Reactor, and Wealth powers.

title: Cloudtop Hotel
description: Fold a little hotel into the clouds. Welcome Bunny, Frog and Cat guests, collect balloons, and build your own paper-powered engine.

title: Deep Salvage
description: Keep a little submarine alive in a drowned world. Salvage square parts and build a beam-powered weapon lab.

title: Pollen Club
description: Tiny bee golf. Pull, launch, and ricochet through five sleepy gardens. Every bloom is a good bloom.

title: Dumpling Disco
description: A one-thumb rhythm kitchen. Flip and steam a dumpling trio through three delightfully bouncy mixes.

title: Floaty Ferry
description: Draw little boat routes through a toy archipelago. Help colorful ducklings find their way home.
